chung.Syllabus Name: Introduction to Information Assurance_Nhập môn an toàn thông tin
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 66 h online + 3 h offline + 1h final exam + 2h practical exam + 78 self-study
chung.Description: This course will introduce fundamental modern information and system protection technology and methods, develop a lifelong passion and appreciation for cyber security.
chung.StudentTasks: Student must get the certification of Introduction to Cyber Security Specialization specialization specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination.
chung.Note:
1. Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100%

2. Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

3. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & Final PE Score >=4 & ((Final TE Score + Final PE Score)/2 + bonus) >= 5

taiLieu: SPEC: Introduction to Cyber Security Specialization
MOOC 3: Real-Time Cyber Threat Detection and Mitigation
clo: Explain underlying concepts related to common cyber security threats, vulnerabilities, and risks.
Explain basics of cyber defense starting with foundational models such as Bell-LaPadula and information flow frameworks.
Explain real-time cyber security techniques and methods in the context of the TCP/IP protocol suites.
Summary advanced and current topics in cyber security, many of which are especially relevant in modern enterprise and infrastructure settings.
danhGia: All studied courses. Each module of course contributes 2-3 questions.
